div.div:
Failures: any error, a cancel at Google, or a state mismatch → 302 /login?error=google.
Password-only email, needConfirmation or EMAIL_EXISTS → 302 /login?error=google_account_exists.
The callback never returns JSON and the session cookies are only set on success.
